column1: Reach on the words and sheets tracks, measured by rendering all 371 of their documents at
281685d90 and at ea29d2d11 with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and byte-comparing. Five changed. The
|ink|% figures are against soffice's own PDF of the same document.
Major-page counts are unchanged on all five (0, 0, 5, 10, 0) and no verdict moves. The whole of
the +0.20 is the Pilot Logbook, which the first three fixes did not touch at all and which the
bottom axis title's placement moves by +0.37 — the one document where this round's most
sourced change reads adversely on the metric, and it is 0.37 of 26.99 on a document that was
already failing by a wide margin.
